Research Question: Can a bounded,fully-reviewed multi-domain teacher corpus be exported with intact policy-only labels and frozen S1/S2 token-matched selections?
Hypothesis: Conservative whole-trajectory review plus strict provenance/encoding can make an executable first SFT comparison without another rollout.
Independent Variable: Planned random versus failure-targeted whole-trajectory selection; no training in this preparation run.
Controlled Variables: 30 candidates/domain reviewed in frozen hash order
nonempty references; all no-op cases held
complete assistant trajectories; no selective targets
Metrics: selection processed/target tokens and turn counts
Evidence Gate: Only reviewed whole trajectories admitted; no truncation,oracle context or unreviewed admission. Prepared runner/data/config and CPU negative controls pass. Real SFT metrics remain from prior probe only.
Cost Bound: Local CPU only; no API,no machine startup,no GPU,no parameter updates. Future single-GPU plans separately frozen,not executed.
Failure Branch: Hold ambiguous,partially acceptable or insufficiently evidenced whole trajectories; do not broaden reviews adaptively to make an experiment pass. If domain/token-matching readiness cannot be met,report genuine blocker.
